steps.title: Configure project dependencies and manifest settings
steps.description: Set up target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and declare required foreground service and notification permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define custom theme and dark visual design system
steps.description: Create XML color palette, Material application styles, and custom button background shapes tailored for YouTube dark mode UI.

steps.title: Create custom vector icons for media, navigation, and exit controls
steps.description: Add vector drawables for navigation, media playback, history, and app exit actions.

steps.title: Design Main Activity layout structure with Exit button
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml header layout to feature an Exit button alongside web action controls.

steps.title: Design Watch History UI layouts
steps.description: Construct XML layout files for HistoryActivity screen display and custom list view item rows.

steps.title: Implement HistoryItem data model
steps.description: Create Java model class encapsulating watch history entry ID, video title, page URL, and timestamp attributes.

steps.title: Build SQLite database helper for watch history
steps.description: Develop HistoryDbHelper for persistent entry insertion, record retrieval, individual deletion, and bulk table clearing.

steps.title: Construct custom HistoryAdapter for list rendering
steps.description: Implement custom BaseAdapter mapping history items to list views with human-readable timestamps and delete listeners.

steps.title: Enhance BackgroundAudioService with complete shutdown capabilities
steps.description: Implement stopForegroundAndAudio method in service to completely kill media sessions, notifications, audio focus, and wake locks on app exit.

steps.title: Implement WebAppInterface JavaScript bridge
steps.description: Create JavascriptInterface bridge class to sync video state changes between web elements and BackgroundAudioService.

steps.title: Inject JavaScript background audio override logic
steps.description: Inject custom JavaScript into WebView overriding Page Visibility API to prevent audio playback suspension when app is backgrounded.

steps.title: Implement Exit button listener and application termination handler
steps.description: Wire up exit button action to pause video media playback, release media resources, unbind service, stop background service, and terminate application process.

steps.title: Develop HistoryActivity screen logic
steps.description: Handle watch history list updates, item navigation callback, single item deletion, and clear history dialog actions.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Final compilation, verification of complete exit and background audio termination capabilities, and project build completion.
